execution_environment.scoring_policy: Hippasus is the sole frozen evaluator environment for the 3–10-video engineering smoke and the formal 100-scene five-metric runs. Wan unguided, adapted-GeCo, and proposed videos are copied there only as SHA-verified read-only derived mirrors and are all scored by the same locked evaluator after the relevant generation/runtime certificates and model/input locks pass.

proposed_offline.comparison_note: offline selection from the four frozen seeds 0,1,2,3; this has four-candidate generation cost and is reported as additional inference budget

candidate_budget_policy.reporting_requirement: Do not describe the proposed offline four-candidate selection as equal sampling cost to the single-seed Wan or adapted-GeCo rows. Report its candidate count and additional generation/inference budget with the formal metric table.

raft_large.checkpoint_sha256_requirement: The evaluator lock must bind the actual SHA256 of the weight-manifest file whose role is relative_motion_raft_large_checkpoint; preprocessing.checkpoint_sha256 must equal that content hash.
raft_large.platform_adaptation_requirement: The original symbolic/default torchvision alias is prohibited. The formal evaluator uses this exact Torch 2.8.0+cu128 / TorchVision 0.23.0+cu128 pair on Blackwell, locks every wheel SHA, runs a fixed-image preprocessing parity certificate, and records the resulting platform adaptation rather than claiming an unmodified historical environment.

met3r.offline_loader_requirement: The evaluator adapter must use only the sealed MASt3R directory and the two declared FeatUp/DINO files. It must reject torch.hub, load_state_dict_from_url, wget, git, huggingface_hub download, and all other network fallback paths at runtime.

long_range_reprojection_error.status: The formal content manifest and guarded adapter must both verify the immutable semantic source identity of every required MegaSaM/UFM weight before smoke.
long_range_reprojection_error.source_closure_requirement: The source snapshot must additionally contain a pinned local facebookresearch/dinov2 source tree compatible with Depth-Anything's localhub architecture construction. The sealed Depth-Anything checkpoint supplies the pretrained parameter state; no DINOv2 network weight download is permitted.
long_range_reprojection_error.native_closure_requirement: Before smoke, lock the Blackwell-compatible build command, toolchain, emitted droid_backends/lietorch_backends/torch_scatter libraries, complete ldd closure, and one GPU kernel-path certificate.

vbench_quality.offline_loader_requirement: A frozen adapter must route every official VBench quality component to these sealed local assets and reject wget, git clone, torch.hub, and all runtime downloader fallbacks.

window_contract.sampling_semantics: The two arrays above are the complete and exclusive decoded-frame sample lists. Each contains 24 samples at source-frame stride 3; no implicit cover window, endpoint, interpolation, or additional frame is used. Frames 119 and 120 remain part of the decode/provenance contract but are not GeCo-Fused samples.
window_contract.denominator_lock: Before comparing methods, seed-0 creates a case-window eligibility lock over these 200 fixed case-window units. Every compared method must return a score for every locked unit; an unavailable unit is a failed evaluation artifact, never a reason to drop that unit from its mean.

parameters.geometry_backbone: facebook/VGGT-1B (the model imported by the fixed original GeCo evaluator)
parameters.motion_backbone: infinity1096/UFM-Base (the model imported by the fixed original GeCo evaluator)
parameters.aggregation: equal-weight mean over the seed-0-locked case-window units; no method-dependent valid-case filtering

parameters.input_tensor_preprocessing: Losslessly decoded RGB frames are converted to float RGB in [0,1], resized to exactly 256x256 using torch bilinear interpolation with align_corners=false and antialias=false, then mapped to [-1,1].
parameters.featup_feature_resolution: FeatUp low-resolution features are upsampled inside the pinned MEt3R entrypoint by its featup branch and then bilinearly interpolated to the 256x256 input tensor grid; no caller-side second feature resize is allowed.
parameters.reduction: arithmetic mean of the five fixed one-second pair scores within each case, then equal-weight mean over the fixed 100-case denominator; a missing pair fails the artifact rather than changing its denominator

parameters.geometry_model: MegaSaM: consistent depth, intrinsics, and camera poses
parameters.correspondence_model: UFM-Base: endpoint correspondence and covisibility validity only
parameters.vggt_omega_exclusion: The LRE code manifest, weight manifest, runtime-load trace, and adapter must reject every VGGT-Omega/vggt_omega role, path, SHA, import, weight, feature, depth, pose, confidence, and residual. Only MegaSaM geometry, UFM correspondences, the locked decoder, and standard numerical dependencies are allowed.
parameters.megasam_temporal_input: Run the full sealed MegaSaM pipeline on all decoded source frames 0..120 inclusive in ascending order; use its final CVD artifact outputs_cvd/<case_id>_sgd_cvd_hr.npz for endpoint 0/120 geometry.
parameters.camera_convention: MegaSaM cam_c2w maps camera coordinates to world. The source-to-target transform is inverse(cam_c2w[target]) @ cam_c2w[source].
parameters.coordinate_convention: UFM uses original decoded 1280x704 endpoint pixel centers. MegaSaM geometry uses its CVD raster (Wm,Hm); transform original to geometry by ((x+0.5)*Wm/1280-0.5, (y+0.5)*Hm/704-0.5), bilinearly sample positive finite depth with align_corners=false, project with the CVD intrinsic, then map target geometry coordinates back with ((x+0.5)*1280/Wm-0.5, (y+0.5)*704/Hm-0.5).
parameters.reprojection: symmetric bidirectional image-plane correspondence residual, after both coordinates are expressed in original decoder pixels, normalized by sqrt(1280^2+704^2)
parameters.case_eligibility: both directions meet minimum valid fraction
parameters.denominator_lock: Seed-0 first establishes the two-direction eligibility mask. Every compared method is evaluated on exactly that locked mask; if it cannot score a locked case, the artifact fails rather than excluding the case. Report the baseline locked denominator and all method coverage.
parameters.aggregation: equal-weight mean over the seed-0-locked eligible cases; report locked_cases/100, method coverage, and both directional residual means
parameters.public_label: Independent Long-Range Reprojection Error (MegaSaM geometry; UFM correspondences)
parameters.scientific_limit: This is independent of the VGGT-Omega diagnostic/selector path, not a ground-truth geometry measurement.
parameters.pre_smoke_certificate: A sealed CPU synthetic reprojection certificate must pass identity, known translation, pose inversion, half-pixel resize, positive-depth/in-bounds masks, and forward/backward symmetry before any video smoke.

relative_total_motion_percent.baseline_anchor: Wan unguided seed-0 input lock v2

parameters.flow_model: Raft_Large_Weights.C_T_SKHT_V2 with the exact official checkpoint URL, file SHA256, torchvision version, and preprocessing transform recorded in the evaluator lock; symbolic DEFAULT aliases are forbidden
parameters.decode_frame_pairs: the locked FFmpeg decoder first emits lossless PNG source frames 0..120, then all adjacent pairs [i, i+1] for i=0..119 are evaluated; OpenCV VideoCapture is forbidden
parameters.resize: OpenCV INTER_AREA to long_side=512, each dimension rounded to nearest multiple of 8, no padding
parameters.per_pair_value: mean L2 flow magnitude over all output pixels in resized-pixel units
parameters.ratio: 100 * method_raw_total_motion / seed0_raw_total_motion for the same case
parameters.zero_anchor_policy: if seed0_raw_total_motion <= 1e-6, mark the case ineligible for every method and report it
parameters.aggregation: arithmetic mean of eligible per-case ratios over the baseline-locked denominator; also report median, raw totals, and eligible_cases/100

vbench_quality.aggregation: the exact official scripts/cal_final_score.py::get_nomalized_score followed by ::get_quality_score, importing the exact pinned scripts/constant.py QUALITY_LIST, DIM_WEIGHT, and NORMALIZE_DIC. The seven raw dimension values are saved alongside the resulting official normalized Quality score; no custom component average is permitted.
vbench_quality.prompt_binding: exact frozen generation prompt per staged video
vbench_quality.denominator_lock: Every one of the 100 seed-0-locked cases and all seven specified quality components must produce finite official VBench values. A missing case, component, or NaN fails the method evaluation artifact; no case or component may be dropped.

prohibitions: No metric, eligibility, threshold, pair, frame index, model, or aggregation change may be selected using test data.

Do not mix scoring environments across methods; Wan baseline, adapted-GeCo, and proposed videos are all scored only in the same frozen Hippasus evaluator environment. The 3–10-video smoke is engineering evidence; the separately locked 100-scene Hippasus run is the formal validation result.

VGGT-Omega Long-Range Residual is a development-only candidate-ranking diagnostic and is prohibited from the formal five-metric table. Formal LRE uses MegaSaM geometry plus UFM correspondences only and is not used by the online or offline selector.
No evaluator may download or replace model weights at runtime.

Every retained smoke or formal metric receipt must embed the SHA of a canonical evaluator lock containing code, a locked adapter entrypoint, the separately locked original core evaluator, model-weight, dependency, decoder, input, and schedule bindings.
